title.en: Chapter 20 — All From the Same Mould

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: هولمز تتبع التماثيل لحد المصنع اللي عملهم.
sentences.en: Holmes traced the statues to the workshop that made them.

sentences.ar: طلع إنهم ستة، انصبوا كلهم بنفس اليوم.
sentences.en: It turned out there were six, all cast on the same day.
And on that same day, a great pearl was stolen.
And the theft happened near the workshop.

sentences.ar: وواحد من عمال المصنع كان مطلوب وقتها.
sentences.en: And one of the workshop’s men was wanted at the time.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: خبّى اللؤلؤة بواحد منهم وهو طري.
sentences.en: Holmes said: he hid the pearl in one of them while it was soft.

sentences.ar: وهلق بيكسرهم واحد واحد لحد ما يلاقيها.
sentences.en: And now he breaks them one by one until he finds it.
